AddComment.description: A new comment; leading and trailing whitespace is dropped.

author.description: Name to write under, such as `claude`; the acting person when left out.

at.description: Position from 1; without one the step goes last.

detail.description: Guidance for the step; blank guidance is none.

expectText.description: The text the step at `at` had when it was read.

version.description: Version of the ticket the change is based on.

BoardDeleted.description: What a board deletion took with it.

deletedTickets.description: Keys of the deleted tickets by number.

BoardDto.description: A board as the API shows it; timestamps are Unix milliseconds.

dispatchEnabled.description: Whether the dispatcher may take tickets from this board.

openTickets.description: Tickets that are neither done nor not needed.

repositoryId.description: Repository the board's work happens in.

ChangeDto.description: Data of a `change` event; the event id carries `seq`.

ChangeStep.description: A change of one step; left out fields stay, a `null` detail removes the guidance.

expectText.description: The text the step had when it was read.

CheckoutDto.description: Where a repository is checked out.

path.description: Root of the main checkout with forward slashes.

ClaimTicket.description: A claim of a ticket for an agent.

force.description: Takes the ticket from another assignee and lifts the locks.

CleanedWorktree.description: A ready worktree the cleanup removed or kept; its branch stays either way.

path.description: Folder on the runner, with forward slashes.

ColumnDto.description: A board column: the statuses plus waiting, which open dependencies derive.

CreateTicket.description: A new ticket; left out fields take the defaults: backlog, normal, needs planning.

allowDuplicate.description: Allows an open ticket with the same title on the board.

dependsOn.description: Ticket keys, case and padding do not matter.

force.description: Lifts the dependency, question and not-needed locks.

labels.description: Entries may hold several labels split by commas.

oneOf.description: Read as text, so an unknown priority is `priority-invalid`.
Read as text, so an unknown status is `status-invalid` as on the legacy board.

steps.description: Texts of work steps, none done.

FinishTicket.description: Finishes a ticket from a folder on a runner, as legacy `board done`; nothing is merged.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria set in the same step; done needs them here or on the ticket.

cwd.description: Absolute folder in the board's repository; a worktree containing it stays.

force.description: Lifts the dependency, question and not-needed locks, never the acceptance lock.

version.description: Version the change is based on; without one it checks none.

branch.description: The ticket's branch, when it runs in a worktree.

readyToMerge.description: Every ticket still on the branch is finished; nothing was merged.

Handoff.description: One-time code that opens a browser session.

HistoryDto.description: One change in a ticket's history.

HookEventDto.description: One hook report; unknown fields are ignored because hooks skip the version handshake.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory of the session.

entrypoint.description: Which Claude client ran the hook.

id.description: Chosen by the reporter, so a resend is recognised.

ticket.description: Ticket key the session was started for.

HookReplyDto.description: What the hook passes on to Claude Code.

additionalContext.description: Text Claude Code adds to the conversation.

env.description: Variables for the environment of the session.

ImportTickets.description: Tickets of other boards of the same project to bring onto this board.

ticketKeys.description: 1 to 200 ticket keys; all move or none.

Me.description: The caller as the daemon sees it.

MoveStep.description: A move of one step to another number.

MoveTicket.description: A move to another column; done needs acceptance criteria, here or on the ticket.

force.description: Lifts the dependency, question and not-needed locks.

oneOf.description: Required; read as text so a missing one is `status-missing` as on the legacy board.

version.description: Version the move is based on; without one the move checks none.

oneOf.description: None when no ticket needs planning.

NextPlanningClaim.description: The next ticket that needs planning, claimed for an agent when one is named.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code` extension.

existing.description: Key of the entity that already exists, such as `ARC-0007` for a duplicate ticket.

ProjectDto.description: A project as the API shows it; timestamps are Unix milliseconds.

version.description: Version the rename is based on.

RunDto.description: A run as the API shows it; timestamps are Unix milliseconds.

finished.description: Whether the run ended and these are its last lines; then no lines will follow.

RunnerDto.description: A machine that checks out repositories.

local.description: Whether this is the daemon's own machine.

SetBoardRepository.description: Points a board to the repository checked out at a folder on a runner.

path.description: Absolute folder on the runner; any folder inside the checkout or a worktree of it.

version.description: Version the change is based on.

StartRun.description: A command to run on the daemon's machine; only token holders may start runs.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory on the daemon's machine.

cwd.description: Absolute folder in the board's repository; without a target the branch starts at its HEAD.

force.description: Lifts the dependency and question locks.

join.description: Joins the first open worktree with the same target, else creates one.

joinTicket.description: Joins this ticket's worktree; a different target gives a warning and an own worktree.

cleanup.description: Ready worktrees removed or kept before the start.

joined.description: The ticket joined an existing worktree.

oneOf.description: A missing target branch the start created.

worktree.description: Folder of the worktree on the runner, with forward slashes.

StepDto.description: A work step; numbers count from 1.

StreamPosition.description: Data of the `ready` and `reset` events: the position the stream continues from.

from.description: Such as `origin/release`, or the branch or commit of the main checkout.

branch.description: Branch of the worktree the ticket works in right now.

targetBranch.description: Branch the ticket merges into; none means the default branch.

unlocks.description: Dependents that become ready once this ticket is done.

waiting.description: Ahead of the work with an open dependency.

worktree.description: Folder of that worktree on its runner.

UpdateTicket.description: A change of fields; left out fields stay, `null` clears those that may be empty.

boardId.description: Moves the ticket to another board of its project.

branch.description: Only null, which clears both branch and worktree; a value is refused.

dependsOn.description: Replaces the dependencies and then ignores the add list; the remove list applies last.

force.description: Lifts the dependency, question and not-needed locks.

version.description: Version the change is based on.

worktree.description: Only null, which clears both branch and worktree; a value is refused.

WritePlan.description: A plan; at least one of plan, handbook and diagram.
